items.stem: Which Korean sentence means "My younger brother is bigger than I am"? Words: 저 = I, 남동생 = younger brother, 커요 = is big, 보다 = than, 더 = more.
Which Korean sentence means "My older brother is the fastest"? Words: 형 = older brother, 빨라요 = is fast, 더 = more, 제일 = the most, 보다 = than.
Translate into English: 너는 지수보다 더 빨라요. Words: 너 = you, 지수 = Jisu (a name), 빨라요 = is fast.
Fill the blank with one Korean word that means "than": 저는 너___ 더 커요.
In the sentence 지수는 저보다 더 예뻐요, who is prettier? Words: 지수 = Jisu, 저 = I (the speaker), 예뻐요 = is pretty, 보다 = than, 더 = more.
